rows.given: All original root test paths are supplied, including when caller selected a single AT.
rows.must: Keep the existing full supplied path set, <=1024 nonempty dict, sorted processing and exact lowercase hash/path contracts. Do not narrow to the selected test to evade the aggregate fault.
rows.must_not: No new loader/source adapter, selector closure claim, dropped test/path or partial verification marked complete.

rows.given: The valid supplied blobs total more than4MiB but every individual file and every formed batch is <=4MiB.
rows.must: Allow multiple bounded body batches within the existing function. Exact4MiB is allowed. Enforce explicit per-file<=4MiB before body reads; reject an individual oversized blob with original fixed refusal.
rows.must_not: Do not raise file cap/path count or read all body blobs into one aggregate buffer. This deliberately changes per-call aggregate cap into per-batch cap; do not claim unchanged cumulative work.

rows.given: The first or a later batch has changed work bytes, CRLF conversion, staged edits or a forged matching work hash.
rows.must: Require immutable expected HEAD blob == supplied SHA256 == raw working file bytes for every path in every batch, preserving original mismatch reason. CRLF is not a normalization exception.
rows.must_not: No checkout-normalization fallback, forged manifest acceptance, early success before later batches or hash-only comparison omitting work==blob.

rows.given: Git batch-check metadata has wrong count/type/object hash/size or an oversized file.
rows.must: Preserve exact header validation, blob type, count matching and bounded decimal size syntax; pair headers/sizes with the correct sorted paths. Oversize must be rejected before body fetch.
rows.must_not: No trusting missing/nonblob/malformed metadata, inferred body lengths or zip truncation that silently skips a file.

rows.given: A first or later body batch has truncated header/body, wrong declared size, missing separating LF or extra trailing bytes.
rows.must: Keep original exact header comparison, bounded header delimiter search, size/body length checks, required LF and cursor==len(raw) independently per batch.
rows.must_not: Do not accept tail bytes at any batch boundary, concatenate batches before framing validation or reuse cursors/metadata from a different batch.

rows.given: Malformed/unknown HEAD, untracked blob, invalid/nested/outside path, malformed hash, symlink or work-size mismatch is supplied.
rows.must: Keep original HEAD and path/hash restrictions, explicit expected-SHA queries, real test-root containment/no-symlink and size+raw read checks, preserving fixed SourceBytesRefused reasons.
rows.must_not: No path discovery/import/evaluation, credentials, untracked source approval or source-head deletion to make runner pass.

rows.given: Any Git command times out/fails, including a later batch.
rows.must: Keep original sanitized read-only Git command construction and timeout=5 on each command; late refusal rejects the whole source binding with original operation reason.
rows.must_not: No retries, larger per-command deadline, credential discovery or claim that the complete multi-command function has a5second total bound.

rows.must: Make batching deterministic and cover each original path exactly once. Maintain <=4MiB blob bodies per batch and one-batch memory processing. Record actual total bytes/batch count separately; at<=1024 paths, at most1024 nonempty batches and <=4GiB aggregate bodies.
rows.must_not: Do not conceal increased cumulative I/O or per-call worst-case command budget; do not claim framing overhead is included in the body cap. No new security permission or external data input is introduced.

rows.given: The existing runner receives successful source verification and then a selected AT13 run.
rows.must: Preserve original fixed AT/spec/binding validation, observed JUnit outcomes, missing/empty-evidence handling and whole_AT_EX/42 whole_status NOT_RUN. Source verification is engineering integrity, not business outcome.
rows.must_not: No formal PASS automatically inferred, AT29/AT33 completion claim, retry of old AT21/32 or marked template/HTTP window, or hidden extra business/model/Windows run.

rows.given: Historical AT21/32 rejection receipts and other delivery evidence are reused.
rows.must: Preserve both SOURCE_BINDING/GIT_BLOB_UNAVAILABLE/0tests original reports and their separate finite already-PASS instances. Reviewer final work remains static-only/product import0; parent execution is counted separately.
rows.must_not: Do not rewrite historical refusals as repaired PASS, count0tests as business FAIL/PASS, transfer results acrossSHA or close old HTTP UNKNOWN.
